name: drift-collection-is-scoped-to-its-shard
find:
- name: Collect reference-frame drift readings
        if: contains(matrix.shard.files, 'tests/test_golden_frames.py')
breaks: the drift collection runs on all three matrix shards while only one of them runs the comparisons, so the other two report `no reference-frame drift readings were taken, so this run measured nothing` on every run, and a permanent warning is one people learn to read past (#797, L36)
